Package ep.service

Class AssignmentManager

java.lang.Object
ep.service.BaseManager
ep.service.AssignmentManager
public class AssignmentManager extends BaseManager
Use case 3, Plan an Assignment from a Deadline. Validates the assignment, asks the ScheduleManager for study blocks, stores the result and reports any shortage. Editing rebuilds the blocks; deleting removes the assignment together with its blocks.

    • addAssignment

      public PlanResult addAssignment(String title, LocalDate dueDate, int estimatedHours, int blockLength, String courseId)
      Adds an assignment and plans its study blocks.
      Parameters:
      title - non-blank title
      dueDate - deadline, today or later
      estimatedHours - total hours, at least 1
      blockLength - preferred block length in hours, between 1 and the estimate
      courseId - linked course or null
      Returns:
      the placed blocks and any shortage
      Throws:
      ValidationException - when a value is invalid; nothing is saved then

    • editAssignment

      public PlanResult editAssignment(String id, String title, LocalDate dueDate, int estimatedHours, int blockLength, String courseId)
      Changes an assignment and rebuilds its study blocks for the remaining hours.
      Parameters:
      id - assignment to change
      title - new title
      dueDate - new deadline
      estimatedHours - new estimate (must not be below completed hours)
      blockLength - new block length
      courseId - new course or null
      Returns:
      the placed blocks and any shortage
      Throws:
      ValidationException - when a value is invalid; nothing is saved then

      public PlanResult replan(Assignment a)
      Throws away the assignment's current blocks and plans its remaining hours again. Called after add/edit, after progress is recorded, and when a new fixed event lands on one of its blocks.

      Returns:
